result.reason: The added New York law and exclusive New York County jurisdiction language facially matches the preferred position, but it conflicts with the unchanged mandatory arbitration provision and its express authorization to confirm awards in other courts, including courts where the adverse party resides. The operative provisions therefore do not establish a coherent exclusive New York venue and may unintentionally alter or obscure the parties’ arbitration arrangement. The edit is otherwise limited to the governing-law sentence, but the dispute-resolution provisions must be harmonized.
